chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Khudri, from some of his elders, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Fast in the coming year on the fifth day from the day you fasted in during the former year.

key_terms.الْعَامُ الْمُسْتَقْبَلُ: the coming year — referring to the next lunar year
key_terms.عَامَ أَوَّلَ: the former year — the previous lunar year
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْخَامِسِ: the fifth day — counting five days forward from the fasting day of the previous year

ai.seo_question: How do you determine the day of fasting for the coming year according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides guidance on determining the day of fasting for the coming year by counting five days forward from the day one fasted the previous year. This hadith addresses the practical matter of identifying the correct day for voluntary or obligatory fasts when the calendar shifts. The instruction of adding five (or six in a leap year) days accounts for the difference between lunar years, helping believers maintain consistent fasting practices.
